Message:
Joining that guy’s journey
was the right choice after all.

This mansion holds information
not only from places
beyond this duchy’s borders,
but other worlds as well.

The Tree of Life and
the Tree of Death.

The Staff of Tikkun and
the Lance of Longinus...

I never would have thought
I’d attain such
fascinating findings...
Coming here has borne
more fruit than I ever
could have imagined.

At first glance,
it appears to be
nothing more than
a list of disconnected
pieces of information.

But...there is one source
that connects them all...

If I can uncover just what
guides that angel’s actions,
everything will be made clear...
